registration: Written before HFD03 outcome comparisons; metadata and identity inventories inspected only

calibration.truth: Stable E0/E1 stem and tree ID, unchanged raw taxon, E0 alive; E1 dated alive/A or stem dead with D token, excluding Miss/MT; positive actual interval. DBH and coordinate eligibility separate.
calibration.target_alignment: Actual E1 date retained as known campaign covariate. Frozen reconstruct first at 2020 origin; secondary tagged-endpoint projection of same unknown-fate kernel uses actual exposure and E0-cell RMS DBH. No claim that 2018 truth is observed 2020 state.

missingness.coupling: Same seed per state/future unit across mechanisms; variable-consumption RNG prevents claim of exact common-uniform coupling

entry_audit.weight_interpretation: Declared sensitivity memberships, not empirically calibrated class probabilities
entry_audit.high: All 6992 measured living candidates as exposure upper bound, not biological assertion

diagnostics.E2: Exposed approximate public aggregates only; no fitting, minimization or corrected primary result
diagnostics.two_point_size: Equal expected count at d/sqrt(1.0625)*[0.75,1.25], preserving expected initial BA; mortality cohort-size independent, juvenile threshold classification can differ

synthetic.selection: Full Cartesian grid; every world retained regardless of truth
synthetic.prior_state: Single public E0 anchor; not truth state or structure/regeneration level
synthetic.discrimination_gate: Established only if primary has >=50 positive/negative independent worlds, sensitivity and specificity >=0.8; otherwise partial/not established. Correct/misspecified suites never pooled.

monte_carlo.interval: Wilson score 95% pointwise Q1; Bonferroni two 97.5% Wilson components Q2; approximate binomial coverage, not simultaneous across cells
monte_carlo.classification: Present required; TRUE if all lower bounds strictly exceed theta; FALSE if absence or any upper bound strictly below theta; otherwise MC_UNRESOLVED
monte_carlo.adequate_target: At maximum K, >=90% conditional cells resolved AND max 95% half-width <=0.04; outer selected-surface state-block SE <=0.03 at N=1024. Report MIXED if any target fails.
monte_carlo.prefixes: Generate fixed maximum bank first; slice paired prefixes. No preferred-Boolean stopping.
monte_carlo.theta_endpoints: Full missingness theta=0/1 reported numerically unresolved when strict MC rule overlaps; deterministic absence still FALSE
monte_carlo.publication_policy: Headline intervals attach to conditional finite-design units. Aggregate Health is a resolved-fraction bracket, not Health of an averaged state.

claims.M3: redundant supporting query-sufficiency illustration; no information gain
